relationships.evidence_quote: Voluntary exercise ameliorates NP that develops in rats after compression injury.

relationships.subject: voluntary exercise
relationships.evidence_quote: SCI-induced NP was accompanied by increased expression of CGRP and Iba-1 in the lumbar dorsal horn. These responses were reduced in rats that underwent voluntary exercise.

key_findings: Voluntary exercise ameliorated mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia after cervical SCI in rats
CGRP and Iba-1 increased in lumbar dorsal horn and were reduced by exercise
